e implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in `src/num.js` — constrains n to the range [min, max] using `Math.max` and `Math.min`.

2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in `src/util.js` — divides by 1024 until the value fits within B/KB/MB/GB, then formats with one decimal place.

3. **`slugify(title)`** in `src/text.js` — lowercases, trims, replaces runs of spaces with dashes, and strips all non-alphanumeric characters except dashes.

All three functions are exported from their modules.
